proposal.action: Impose punitive restrictions on every resident of a defined community after a serious violent attack committed by a small number of people associated with that community, regardless of individual involvement.
proposal.purpose: Punish the community, demonstrate consequences and deter future attacks by making the wider population bear costs for the attackers' conduct.
proposal.requested_authority: Apply curfews, property closures and financial restrictions collectively without individual evidence of wrongdoing.

evidence.claim: A serious violent attack occurred and caused deaths and injuries.
Investigators have evidence implicating a small number of identifiable individuals in planning or carrying out the attack.
There is no individual evidence linking the large majority of residents who would be restricted to the attack or its planning.
Officials argue that imposing costs on the wider community may deter future support for attackers.
The proposed restrictions would predictably affect uninvolved residents' movement, employment, property use, family life and access to services.
Individual investigation, arrest of identified suspects, targeted protective measures and evidence-based restrictions on specifically implicated persons are feasible.

affected_parties.party: Victims and survivors of the attack
affected_parties.interests_or_risks: Justice, protection from further violence, truth and effective prevention.

affected_parties.party: Identified suspects and people with individual evidence against them
affected_parties.interests_or_risks: Due process, proportionate security measures and individual accountability.

affected_parties.party: Uninvolved residents of the targeted community
affected_parties.interests_or_risks: Freedom from punishment for others' acts, movement, livelihood, property, family life and access to services.
Prevention of further attacks, public confidence and operational effectiveness.
Safety, equal application of law, social trust and avoidance of retaliatory escalation.

alternatives.description: Investigate and prosecute individually identified suspects using ordinary evidence and due process.
Use targeted, evidence-based temporary security measures against specifically identified risks.
Apply the proposed collective punitive restrictions to the whole community to create deterrent pressure.
Use community-protection, intelligence and prevention measures that do not make uninvolved residents bear punishment for others' acts.

uncertainties: Whether collective punishment would produce any net deterrent effect.
Whether collective measures would instead increase grievance, fear or future security risk.
Which additional individuals, if any, may later be linked to the attack through evidence.
declared_conflicts_of_interest: Officials may face political pressure to demonstrate rapid and visible retaliation after a serious attack.
requested_capability: Punish and restrict an entire community as a deterrent despite the absence of individual evidence against most affected residents.
